Sam / procurement team —

Thanks again for a productive eval week. Per our last call I pulled together a tight activation plan so we can lock dates for signatures and the start date. High level asks:

- Can Ava confirm legal and procurement availability for a 48-hour signature window the week of Mar 1–5 (we recommend Mar 2–3 as signer slots)?
- Will you target an internal approval decision by Feb 26 so we can prep the DocuSign envelope and finalize the SOW redlines?
- Confirm target production start date. We propose Mar 10 to give operations time after signatures.

Attached is the latest mutual action plan (MAP_v5.pdf) and a one-page signature block (Signature_Block.pdf) with the exact routing we intend. The MAP includes milestones, point owners, required approvals (legal, finance, security), and fallback options if signatures slip beyond the week of Mar 1.

If those dates work, I will:
- Lock the DocuSign envelope and notify all signers by Feb 27.
- Trigger our onboarding kickoff for Mar 11 (ops will be ready to start ramping on Mar 10 once the agreement is fully signed).

Please confirm availability by end of day Tue Feb 24 so we can hold the slots.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
